items.title: The localization at a closed subset of the form V(f_1, ..., f_r) of a w-contractible ring is w-contractible
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file proetale.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a closed subset Z of the spectrum of A of the form V(f_1, ..., f_r), if A is w-contractible then so is the localization A_Z^tilde (statement lines 2282-2287). The proof (proof lines 2289-2305) extends a given weakly etale faithfully flat map by the localizations at the f_i, takes a retraction using w-contractibility of A, and uses the specialization property of A_Z^tilde to conclude that the image lies in the intended component. H2: a three-step argument with two inputs, written out in full.
